notes.title: 🚨 New game Out of Bounds is NOW AVAILABLE! 🚨
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, everybody! How have you been?[/b]

We're doing PRETTY WELL! Closing this crazy 2022 celebrating 🥳

And that's not only because [url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/20/sport/argentina-football-team-arrival-intl-hnk-spt]our football team won the World Cup[/url], but also because we have just released a new game on Steam:

[url=https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png[/img][/url]

Out of Bounds is a peculiar title that was originally created for a game jam the past year ([url=https://itch.io/jam/2021-epic-megajam]Epic Megajam 2021[/url]). As a solo dev, I had 7 days to create a game that was later [url=https://tobiasrusjan.itch.io/out-of-bounds]released for free on Itchio[/url].

Since I liked the result of the jam, I decided to keep working on that idea for the next months and also some great devs (former colleagues from other projects) joined me to get the best results in visuals ([url=https://twitter.com/viktorahmed]Viktor Ahmed[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scuzzostuff/]Claudio "Scuzzo" Sagrera[/url]) and audio ([url=https://twitter.com/davyd_music]David Levill[/url]) 🙌



[h1]THE GAME[/h1]

Out of Bounds is a title about "creating" a game and "fixing" bugs... Yeah, it's crazy. You will pickup blueprints, compile shaders, test sound effects, drink a lot of coffee. But watch out for the bugs! Grab your Line Tracer and get rid of them 👾

https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg
Things are starting to get better here in Saibot Studios and Out of Bounds is part of that process. I'm looking forward to bring you news about bigger projects in the future, but for now give a chance to this crazy puzzle shooter with humor and puzzles 🤓

You can follow Out of Bounds on its new Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/OutOfBoundsVg



[h1]NEWS ABOUT EXPLOSIONS AND GORE?[/h1]

Hell yeah! The people at [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/]Humble Bundle[/url] created [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle]a new package of retro style first person shooters[/url] based on the one they did in March of this year 🔥

[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d71afde69b8306dbbb108c8e6fbcb9e42f3a60d0.png[/img][/url]

This time, you can get 7 awesome titles for only 12 dollars, including our own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and the great [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590910/Forgive_Me_Father/]Forgive Me Father[/url] was also added to the list.

A percentage of the sales will go to charity at [url=https://ablegamers.org/]Able Gamers[/url] and [url=https://www.starlight.org/]Starlight Children's Foundation[/url] ❤️

Hurry up! Get the bundle before the next 24 hours ⏲️



If you have a Twitter account, don't forget to follow us for more news:
https://twitter.com/SaibotStudios

Cheers and take care!

[url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan][i]Tobías[/i][/url]

notes.title: 📦 COLLECTION + SPECIAL VIDEO + MORE! 🪙
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28189/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/2baf71e0692653c469784f5518da8d0bd44810da.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Hello there! How are you? How's your 2022 so far? 😎[/h1]

From here, we have a few things to tell you...

As we mentioned you in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/SaibotStudios/announcements/detail/3123813809682672635]last post[/url], this year we reached an entire decade since we started making games as an independent team in Saibot Studios. But it was just now that we actually make something special to celebrate it. [url=https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo]Check out the special video![/url]

https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo

Together with this video, we built and launched a collection with all our published games, including: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?franchise=Doorways]the Doorways saga[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431780/The_Black_Heart/]The Black Heart[/url] 😈

[b]> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28189/]LINK TO BUNDLE[/url] <[/b]

Buying the games from the bundle, gives you a 15% of discount on all the titles. And if you already have one or more of the games included in the package, it will discount you the titles you're missing without needing to buy the entire bundle 👌



[h1]TENEBRIS SOMNIA[/h1]

On the other hand, we receently announced our new creation: Tenebris Somnia. This is a very unique title by the great [url=https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andr%C3%A9s_Borghi]Andrés Borghi[/url], creator of The Black Heart 🖤

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3dc732cee7c111bb33503e507a649dcf3d66ae79.png[/img][/url]

We're developing this project Andrés and I ([url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan]Tobías Rusjan[/url]), together with a great team of artists. You can read more about it and the dev team [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2121510/view/3307354336731266403]in this other post[/url] we did the past week.

If you like the concept of the game, don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/]add it to your Wishlists[/url]. We're aiming to have it ready during 2023 👍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/



[h1]OUT OF BOUNDS[/h1]

In the mean time, I keep working on my little jam game Out of Bounds, a rare title with action, shooting and puzzles. We released a demo in June and it's still available to check directly from the store page:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png[/img][/url]

My idea is finish the full game for the end of the year. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/]So play the demo and add it to your wishlist if you liked it![/url] 🙌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/



[h1]HELLBOUND... HELLBOUND?[/h1]

This month we received the great news from our (now) former publishers that they're giving us back the IP of Hellbound 🤯

What does this mean?

Finally, we at Saibot Studios are going to start receiving sales from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] on Steam. Since the release of 2020, all the sales went to the publisher because that was what we stablished: they recoup their investment first, and then we split; but we never reached that last step because they never recoup their part with the sales we had.

But now after two years from the release, they're giving us back the game so we can atleast see some of the sales. Also, we got back the full rights of the project to take any desision we want from now on 🔥

[url=https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/5d56edecbe4128de8d9912896496161a814e16f3.png[/img][/url]

In March of this year there was the Best of Boomer Shooters Bundle, the first collection of Humble Bundle focused on retro FPSs. Hellbound had the honour to be included in that package, becoming the first argentinian game in participate in the iconic Humble Bundle:

https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM

Both the sales from this collection and also the sales from now on (September of 2022) at Steam are going to us at Saibot. Yes, finally!

But unfortunately, this aren't earnings for us yet, since we still need to recoup all we put to create the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/802200/Hellbound_Survival_Mode/]Hellbound: Survival Mode[/url] in 2016-2018.

So the future of Hellbound is still uncertain... The good thing is that everything has started looking brighter now, we'll see how things turn for our Hellgore in the next months 🤞



That would be all for now, people. Hope we have some more news for you soon, follow us in our networks to stay updated:
[list]

[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/saibotstudios/]Instagram [/url]

[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCa29sOnJRNG-ZLGU2GfNNow]You Tube[/url]
[/list]

Cheers, everybody! Take care!

[i]Tobias[/i]

notes.title: 🎂 10 YEARS OF SAIBOT! 🎉
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/7b810cd997a89e0c3e44b1a3488243164ef329ce.png[/img]



[h1]Hello, people! How are you? How did you started 2022? 🤓[/h1]


In a day like today, but from 2012, we officially started a crazy adventure called [url=http://saibotstudios.com]Saibot[/url] that continues to date.

Actually, the very begginning was in 2011 with the conceptualization and prototype of what ended up being our first title Doorways ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/SaibotStudios/announcements/detail/3039340060183828773]read more[/url]).


But it wasn't until March of 2012 that, after I partened with my Uncle and friend Ivan Rusjan, we finally started working as a team. We built the first Saibot "office", which was actually my room along side the bed and at my Mom's department, and we used some old tables as desks that my Grandma gave us ❤️

And from then, a lot of enechdotes and experiences started hapenning. With tons of fails and drop downs, but also with some wins, we were able to keep going to date doing what we love the most: creating our own games and delivering them all over the world 🌎

So I decided to take some time to build and share with you a quick recap of some of the main milestones we have achieved together with you during the last 10 years of Saibot...



[h1]2012: The Origin[/h1]
[list]
[*] Started the team and office with only two members (picture)

[*] Started the development of the first game and saga: [url=https://doorwaysgame.com/]Doorways[/url]

[*] First public presentation of the game at the event EVA 2012
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d9a7ea9b6833fb127135c0a1ac1a73a9c7a57c20.jpg[/img]

[i]Left: Tobias Rusjan (me), right: Martin Voychisko[/i]



[h1]2013: Prelude[/h1]
[list]
[*] Trip to E3 thanks to a contest we won at Indies Crash E3

[*] Approval of our first game at Steam Greenlight after a lot of [url=https://youtu.be/dg1r_wfViT4]big Youtubers[/url] played it

[*] Official launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/248470/Doorways_Prelude/]Doorways: Prelude[/url] on Steam (first argentinian game to be released on Steam after being approved on Greenlight)

[*] Launch of VR (virtual reality) version of Doorways: Prelude with the Oculus Rift Dev Kit 1 (first argentinian game published with VR compatibility)
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/7284455e8752bf7471fd8c426f1d49e7950547b9.jpg[/img]

[url=https://youtube.com/watch?v=OI5-LjhxsbE][i]Most popular Youtuber Pew Die Pie playing Doorways: Prelude[/i][/url]



[h1]2014: Underworld[/h1]
[list]
[*] Moved to new home-office with our own space

[*] Team got bigger with 4 full time developers

[*] Development and release of the second game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/311250/Doorways_The_Underworld/]Doorways: The Underworld[/url]

[*] Hosted a special event with Youtubers Alfredito and international guest Xoda (Chile) playing Doorways: The Underworld live

[*] Trip to Esquel (Chubut, Argentina) together with the development team (picture)
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/c679b99e4bf7fe08ac1620b56872e7961c403691.jpg[/img]

[i]From left to right: David Levill, Sergio Juarez (my Father), Damian Teixeira, Tobias Rusjan (yo), Maximiliano Schneider[/i]



[h1]2015: Holy Mountains[/h1]
[list]
[*] Team got even bigger with 6 developers working full time

[*] Started the creation of the biggest title of the saga [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383930/Doorways_Holy_Mountains_of_Flesh/]Doorways: Holy Mountains of Flesh[/url]

[*] Release of an early version of the game as Early Access in Steam

[*] Published the first [url=https://youtu.be/eWacVGyUgkI]live action promotional video[/url] directed by Andrés Borghi (picture)
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3cbde0802de6ab11d99a3696b008f75ae9c7cd9e.jpg[/img]

[i]Dev team members from Saibot together with the cast and live action video creators ([url=https://www.facebook.com/pennylaneproductora/photos/t.100004124281878/182581308800020]see tags[/url])[/i]



[h1]2016: Transition[/h1]
[list]
[*] Final release of Doorways: Holy Mountains of Flesh on Steam

[*] Built and release of the old version of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/525780/Doorways_Old_Prototype/]Doorways: Old Prototype[/url] created in late 2011

[*] Started working on new series Hellbound

[*] Team member David Levill decided tattoo himself the logo of "Doorways" on his skin because of the love he had to the project (picture)
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3ac04849ab6987f9a81b8ce7f204ebefe967ee22.jpg[/img]

[i]Tattoo painted by Fernando Muzzio (main artist from Hellbound) over the left arm of David Levill (music director and SFX composer)[/i]



[h1]2017: New Beginning[/h1]
[list]
[*] New team members were introduced for a much bigger project in Hellbound

For the creation of this particular video, we did live action takes as references, then did motion captures (MoCap), and finally rendered everything with high quality specs; everything done here in Argentina 🇦🇷

[url=https://youtu.be/uMN1pEmfz-Y][i]Watch the first presentation of the teaser trailer at the expo EVE 2017[/i][/url]



[h1]2018: Survival Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*] Launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/802200/Hellbound_Survival_Mode/]Hellbound: Survival Mode[/url] as Early Access

[*] Created a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tobiasrusjan/hellbound-a-90s-first-person-shooter-made-20-years]Kickstarter campaing for Hellbound[/url] to complete the funds for the campaign

[*] Hellbound: Survival Mode wons a price at expo EVA 2018 as best game created in Unreal Engine (picture)
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/c9f3becc315ac9143daa5282e07e34a79a98eb57.jpg[/img]

[i]From left to right: Paulo Souza (Epic Games evangelist), Tobías Rusjan (me), Miguel Martín (director at ADVA)[/i]



[h1]2019: Campaign Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*] Moved with the team at a [url=https://youtu.be/YjMy0tRz32M]bigger and better home-office[/url] located in the town of Vicente Lopez (Buenos Aires)

[*] Definitive launch of Hellbound: Survival Mode (first published argentinian game to have animations withe motion capture)

[*] Launch of [url=https://youtu.be/4HcI6QgDubk]Hellbound's demo (campaign mode)[/url] together with a presentation at EVA 2019 (picture)

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/79bddaa6553a1977e41a6bd2da46dcdfd8d69f3b.jpg[/img]

[url=https://youtu.be/s3f3W9e_59M][i]Hellbound's launch trailer[/i][/url]

notes.title: 🔥 Hellbound: Flying Souls Update (v1.1.1) 🔥
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/506333d226fbc95ee57883f6635f105a22a35b8c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Major Update: Flying Souls (v1.1.1) 🌋[/b][/h1]

HELLo, soldiers of Hell! How have you been?

We’ve been in overdrive preparing things for the end of the year and have some explosive new stuff for you! Are you ready? Check this out!

https://youtu.be/1Jc_yza1upM
Since we released the update in August, at Saibot Studios we have been working non-stop fixing bugs, improving the game in general, and at the same time creating new content. So we bring you...

[list]
[*][b]Flying Souls[/b]: The true new level 5 of the campaign. The most complex and varied scenario of all: with indoor and outdoor confrontations and with the highest amount of secrets: 10 (SPOILER: 3 of which are almost-impossible and combined); and aesthetically SHOCKING: a floating island in the clouds, with two huge rings rotating around it.

[*][b]Pygon[/b]: a completely new enemy that’s different from all the rest. It flies, spits energy balls that deal area damage, and teleports to dodge your attacks. We also added this creature to the next levels, so we recommend re-playing them as well.

[*][b]Ground Zero[/b]: We recreated the classic Survival Mode scenario that we launched back in 2018 in the new version of the game, and we included it both in the original game (optional) and in the campaign. Among many other improvements compared to the classic, the new one has high-quality textures, new and improved 3D models, character ragdolls, bloodstains on the stage, new animations and visual effects for weapons, remastered music, Hellgore character voices, and much more!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/bff2bb193701adc63fef2e5570d1d716da91a00c.jpg[/img]

Doing all this was an investment that was not in the plans. Our Publisher Nimble Giant supported our development until the August release and we are grateful for that. Although both teams were very proud of the product we achieved, the sales results were not as expected.

We at Saibot then decided to go one step further and invest what little money we had left to continue improving and expanding the game, thus giving Hellbound the closure it deserves. Unfortunately, we are far from the game recouping its investment or for us to see any revenue in sales and thus be able to continue expanding the game even more.

That is why this update that we bring you today is a gift for all of you who have been supporting us, so that you can enjoy even a little more of this crazy project that was so important to us. It won't be as big a gameplay extension as you expected, but this is because our vision (commercially flawed probably) was always focused on making a small, high-quality product in all aspects of the game by adding tons of handcrafted details in each scene, enemy, item, weapon, etc. That was always our main objective; in addition to (of course) invoking the spirit of the classic FPS that we are so passionate about.

Each level of the campaign took us between 3 and 4 months of hard work, with an incredible development team of 6 people (of which only 4 were full time). The levels are built by hand, without any type of pattern or modular objects like tiles. This makes everything look more varied and organic, which was what we wanted; instead of repeated and simple.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/50bf5b35fe32b20ece8bb66d579ebf92350fbdc9.jpg[/img]

We’re taking this update as an opportunity to say goodbye to Saibot's current team as we will not be in a financial position to continue supporting the team until further notice. Next year a new phase will begin for everyone, with new journeys, opportunities and new projects.

Thanks again to everyone who supported us, these past 5 years have been truly AMAZING, we grew SO MUCH and built something GREAT together.


We leave you with screenshots of the new content, we hope you like it as much as we do.

Cheers from the unstoppable team at Saibot Studios!

[i]Tobías Rusjan[/i]

notes.notes:
Hey everybody! How are you doing? 😷

We're doing very well, entirely working in Hellbound as always. But this time and due to the quarantine established here in Argentina because of COVID 19, every one of us is working from home 😎

Even though the project originally started with all of us working from distance, during the last year and a half some of us have been sharing the same working place.

We started at the old Saibot office located in Caballito (Capital Federal of Buenos Aires), and most recently we moved to Vicente López (province of Buenos Aires).

notes.title: 🤓 A year of progress 😎
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! It’s been awhile, how have you been?

Today a year has passed since the conclusion of our Kickstarter, that’s why we want to make a brief recap about the state of the project 🧐

As you maybe remember, our original goals here were:
[list]
[*]Finish the Survival Mode
[*]Build The Heroes’ Cemetery for all of our backers
[*]Create an entire playable level of the Campaign Mode to convince investors
[/list]

Well, “let's go by parts”, said Hellgore while he was ripping and tearing a poor Vlader…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/af34e46cd1f6a23507f6632086ad59e629e4725b.jpg[/img]
[i]Viktor (right), Fercho (center) and I (left) during late night working[/i]



[b]THE SURVIVAL MODE[/b]

During past year (2018) we did some adjustments, but the real upgrades will come with the release of the Campaign Mode, since we’re going to make use of all the progress made there.

We can’t add those improvements to the active version of the game at Steam yet, because we’re still working on the internal structure of the engine. But we can tell you that we’re working with the experimented team of programmers at NGD Studios for that, so the game can achieve the best results in performance and porting 👍

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/82eb8289b4ce725205866daa5f6f49615c3e94f0.jpg[/img]
[i]NGD programming team during a master class[/i]



[b]THE HEROES' CEMETERY[/b]

We decided that this place is going to be an entire level of the Campaign Mode, where all the immortalized souls (from Kickstarter and from [url=http://hellboundgame.com/]our website[/url]) rest in Hell forever.

Since our last post on April, we have been organizing all the information given by you guys (names, photos, phrases), and we slowly started designing every headstone, bust and statue. Soon enough, there will be updates on this as well. Here’s a quick spoiler of the cemetery:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/ee0b7304b3792e6bc43133de5cb53e834c29b0d0.jpg[/img]
[i]A quick look of cemetery’s ground[/i]



[b]THE CAMPAIGN MODE[/b]

So here’s where we have been dedicated most of our time, sweat and blood (mostly blood for sure).

As we’ve just mentioned you, we’re working with NGD Studios, who currently our publishers for Hellbound. This is allowing us to create, not only one single level of the campaign, but an entire episode ✌️

Right now 25% of the levels from the game have (almost) final visuals and audio; 50% count with gameplay placements (enemies, items, areas, doors, switches, Etc.); and 100% was already blocked out (”grey boxes”).

Today we have created more than 1000 props with materials and textures; 5 new items; 3 new music soundtracks; 1 new enemy, and more…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/e9d8271621aad31e94c3df415356f8f0a0a40080.jpg[/img]
[i]Just a few of the many props created for the environments[/i]



We want to reveal final screenshots of the game very soon, but we’re still working on that, and we also need to find a better timing (a day before E3 isn’t the best moment of course).


Thank you for this amazing year! Keep on [url=https://www.facebook.com/HellboundVideogame]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/HellboundGame]Twitter[/url] 👍

Cheers from the team at Saibot Studios!

[i]Tobías Rusjan[/i]

YOUR NAME ON THE BIG WALL

Their name or nickname will be displayed on The Big Wall. This is a 65 feet tall wall located in the center of the cemetery, and it’s a “must-see” for all the tourists.

notes.title: 🕍 Campaign Mode - Environments 🕍
notes.notes:
HELLo, creatures from HELL! How have you been?

Today we’re finally revealing new information about the ‘Campaign Mode’ of Hellbound 😎

But first, let me do a recap...


We started this year focusing on an important milestone known as the “Vertical Slice”, which as some of you may know, consists of building a fully playable part of the game (a level in our case).

Having pretty much completed this, I’m happy to report that we now have the workflow defined for the rest of the levels, as well as the general visual aspects we want for them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/d8f6d5759dcfb662a6d723d7c3db5821ffe23ab5.jpg[/img]
[i]This is how I looked after that milestone…  bald. Just kidding, it’s pretty hot in Buenos Aires[/i] 😛


And speaking of levels, we are working with the great Leonardo "Leo" Pellegrini, who is a master in creating retro FPS maps like the ones we all loved back in the day. He is also one of the level designers on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/562860/Ion_Maiden/]Ion Maiden[/url] (published by 3D Realms).

notes.title: ☠️ DooM-PlatforM ☠️
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! How's your weekend doing?

Today we want to share with you some "background-history" of Hellbound 🤓

The screenshots you will find below are from a game called DooM-PlatforM, a 2D version of the classic #DOOM (1993) which I created during highschool (between about 2001 and 2005).

It was made using DIV 2 and Fenix, and ofcourse also using the resources of the oginal DOOM (sprites, sound effects and music).

The game is available for free on its [url=http://doomplatform.com.ar/]official website[/url], but you need DOS Box to run it, since it was made for Windows XP:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/230be54d5639114450150018abde3cff3dcc772b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/030d7db7c9043a7693dc8e5b10b5921f3576636b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/49820f22ab70d4e6dfbb62d3e6818405537467c1.jpg[/img]

DooM-PlatforM was an important project for me, since it was one of the first I finised from start to end.

But it was also the game that allowed me to enter in the industry of video game development in 2007.

And the most curious thing is that the company interested in it was none other than NGD Studios, who a decade later became the publishers of our ow game Hellbound (inspired by the 90s FPS classics like DOOM) (y)

The game I made DooM-PlatforM has a Single Player Campaign with 4 leves, but also another 4 levels of Multiplayer with shared screen and inputs (not for network).

But it also includes a Level Editor for the Multiplayer levels. So you can create your own maps, load them and fight againts your friends or even againts a basic AI from the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/fc64d7605c20a348dd2c32ee989ee655072dc27c.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/28396984133b7c3fafc05fdf88420e74fe534087.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/cf3b5336bbf32e22c041b8ad9fed9f3492e41419.jpg[/img]

And yes, you can download all of that from [url=http://doomplatform.com.ar/descargas.html]this page[/url]. But again, you will need DOS Box to run it ;)


I talked a little more about that in this conference I made about my story in EVA 2016 (minute 14:20), it's in spanish but it has english subtitles:

https://youtu.be/FJ4gcRqHoD4?t=860

notes.title: Version Update v0.18.06
notes.notes:
Hello again! New version v0.18.06 is now live! B)

We have been very busy with the Kickstarter, but were able to make some fixes and improvements base on the feedback you guys gave us here, thanks for that!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/a9ccc491ee1f8f33e1f569a2b37c29fbdc272bd8.png[/img]


We have restricted the maximun amount of enemies at the same time, to avoid performance issues.

This was something that really bother on Wave 10. And to keep the difficulty (and even make it harder), we have added something called "Enemy Rage!".
Basically, when you get that far on the game, enemies start getting tougher, faster and bigger.

So let's see how far you guys can make it now!

The full list of fixes and improvements can be seen below ;)


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tobiasrusjan/hellbound-a-90s-first-person-shooter-made-20-years]And we're still on Kickstarter! Let's keep pushing guys![/url]

Tobias and the team at Saibot Studios


----


v0.18.06


NEW FEATURES

- Enemy Rage
- Magnetic Item Pickup
- Options-Game: Magnetic Item Pickup


BUG FIXES

- Main menu performance issues in some specific cases
- Cannot pickup Ammo Pack at the beginning of the game


GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS

- Maximum amount of characters restricted
- Engine updated to last stable version: Unreal Engine 4.19.2
- Better distinction for Health items (hearts)

notes.title: Version Update v0.18.04
notes.notes:
New update for v0.18.04 is now available!

Now we have Full Controller Support, new Power Up "Hell Speed", configurations for Crosshairs and a BUNCH MORE!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/3b7790efcc8ee414a43cbcaa1c8976b122f910f5.png[/img]

We have been listening to all the feedback you guys gave us at the forums ;)

The new version is currently available at Steam. If you didn't receive it automatically, remember you can force it to update following this steps:
- Go to your library of games
- Right mouse click on "Hellbound: Survival Mode" > Properties
- Enter in Local Files > Verify integrity of game cache

Below is a list of the most important adds, fixes and improvements we have made ;)

And at this tweet you can find the official top scores from last version (v0.18.03):
https://twitter.com/HellboundGame/status/986988114324451328

The scores are now reseted with the new update, since the gameplay was affected ;)

Cheers from the team at Saibot Studios!

Tobias


----


v0.18.04


NEW FEATURES

- New Power Up: Hell Speed
- Full Controller Support (tested with gamepads from X Box One, X Box 360 and Play Station 4)
- Options-Game: Crosshair Settings (enable, image, color, size, opacity) with real time Preview
- Options-Controls: Gamepad Settigs (horizontal and vertical sensitivity, invert Look, vibration, invert thumbsticks, key bindings)
- Options-Video: Vertical Sync
- Navigation thru menues using only Keyboard or Gamepad


BUG FIXES

- Sometimes player falls thru the ground when dying
- Wrong screen resolution on startup
- Steam VR launches without sense
- Buttons from menus can't be selected in low resolutions
- Some Power Ups stay forever available after spawn


GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS

- Running using Shift (default) does not prevent player to shoot or change weapon any more
- - Sprinting (even faster than Run) is still available by holding both Run and Crouch keys
- Explosions from Rockets and Grenades now affect the owner
- Minimun ratio from Explosions of Rockets, Grenades and Fruits reduced by half
- Plants close to the shores moved to avoid player of hiding
- Menu fonts improved
- Saturation of main loading screen reduced to avoid seizures
- Power Ups sound effects improved and highlighted
- Power Up Hell Damage feedback reduced, and now it always breaks enemies when kills
- Thunder feedback when a Power Up spawns
- Player and enemies speed increased
- Bouncing sound effects added to Grenades
- New Crosshairs for Head Crusher, and zoomed versions of Simple Shotgun and Indolora
- Unreal Engine version updated to 4.19.1

notes.notes:
HELLo everybody! How are you doing?

We want to share with you how we're organizing this project [url=http://hellboundgame.com/?s=game]Hellbound[/url] ;)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32020252/7dabdebad6b9e8baebe242932b7691ac67c9a270.png[/img]

Right now the game is about what you see here: a Survival Mode.
But our idea is to also create a Single Player Campaign. The thing is right now in [url=http://hellboundgame.com/?s=about]Saibot Studios[/url] we're not in economic conditions to face a Single Player Campaign.

So depending on how things go during next month (March, 2018), we believe we're going to know if we can affort a Single Player Campaign or not.

The Survival Mode is currently in Closed Beta. Which can be acceded from [url=http://hellboundgame.com/]the official site[/url] by two of the following options:

- By registering and waiting a few days to get a free key for the Closed Beta.

OR

- Paying and supporting the project, and in exchange receiving a key for the Closed Beta instantly, and then a Definitive Key for the Final version of the game when this one comes out.

The Final version of the game could be only the Survival Mode upgraded, but it could also include the Single Player Campaign. But unfortunately and as we mentioned you before, we can't guarated this last thing.


For any question you have, you can always ask us here or by:
